description: Scopes SKIPPED entirely by doc_path_validator.nim (DEBT#403). Entries in 'archived' cover retrospective/retired documents (historical refs, no longer active claims). Entries in 'skippedDocs' cover forward-plan scopes (e.g. docs/design/) whose normal function is to reference future file paths that do not yet exist — such refs are normative for design documents and must not be treated as stale. Both lists use the same glob/semantics as the whitelist (directory prefix with trailing '/', exact files, glob patterns).
